features.name: `shader`
features.meaning: GPU procedure

features.name: `#import "Basic";`
features.meaning: Import a module; `Basic` is the only one

features.name: `#run expr`
features.meaning: Evaluate with bounded configurable shared work and aggregate storage

features.name: `#assert expr;`
features.meaning: A compile-time `bool` check at the top level; an always-on check as a statement

features.name: `#test "name" { }`
features.meaning: A check run by `coax test`, never compiled into the program

features.name: `#forall a: T, b: lo..<hi { }` (optionally `#forall "name" ...`)
features.meaning: A check over every combination of its bindings

features.name: `#authority;`
features.meaning: Every procedure in the file needs a check; checks run on every build

features.name: `#export_c`
features.meaning: After a procedure's signature: give it its own C name and the C calling convention (`coax lib`, `coax header`)

features.name: `#foreign`
features.meaning: After a procedure's signature, with no body: import a C function that passes only integers, floats and `bool`

features.name: `#import_proto "file.pb" as Prefix;`
features.meaning: Generate types and bounded codecs from a protobuf descriptor set (CPU code only)

features.name: `#load "part.coax";`
features.meaning: Add a once-only source unit with relative paths, cycle/budget checks and physical-file authority

features.name: `#if`

features.name: `#insert` `#expand` `#text` `#location`

features.name: `#derive(...)`
features.meaning: Generate operations from fields

features.name: `#bake_arguments`
features.meaning: Explicit partial specialization

features.name: `#distinct`
features.meaning: A new type with the same representation

features.name: `#as`
features.meaning: Declared conversion to an embedded field
